facts.summary: Missed primary endpoint, development discontinued · Phase 2b · GB0139 in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The GALACTIC-1 trial did not meet its primary endpoint of change from baseline in rate of decline in forced vital capacity (FVC). Based on the results of the GALACTIC-1 trial, Galecto plans to discontinue development of GB0139.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The GALACTIC-1 trial did not meet its primary endpoint of change from baseline in rate of decline in forced vital capacity (FVC).
evidence.safety: Treatment-emergent serious adverse events, which included worsening of IPF, were observed in 7.8% of patients in the GB0139 group and 1.4% of patients in the placebo group.
evidence.program_discontinued: Based on the results of the GALACTIC-1 trial, Galecto plans to discontinue development of GB0139.
